common.model_custom_placeholder: e.g. distil-whisper/distil-large-v3 or a local path

file.drop: Drop a file here or click to browse
file.simple_hint: Switch to Advanced to tweak the model, language, and decoding knobs

youtube.responsibility: You are responsible for download rights.
youtube.diarize_toggle_hint: Multi-speaker videos get per-speaker labels in the subtitles

realtime.preparing_hint: First connect takes ~10s to load the model. Subsequent connects are instant. Press Esc to cancel.
realtime.idle_hint: Press Connect to start streaming mic / tab audio into live subtitles.
realtime.ready_hint: Ready. Start speaking and subtitles will appear live.
realtime.stopped_hint: Session ended · {{count}} confirmed lines. Press ‘New session’ to start again.
realtime.vad_hint: Lower = catches quiet sounds. Too low and silence is never detected, so subtitles never finalise.
realtime.saved_hint: This session was saved to History. Edit / export from the detail page.
realtime.record_hint: Persist audio so you can replay / edit / region-retranscribe after stopping (1h ≈ 115MB)

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.diarize_unavailable: Diarization needs: (1) a HuggingFace token in .env, (2) accepted pyannote model terms, (3) a token with ‘gated repo access’. The HuggingFace card in Settings tells you exactly which one is blocking.
pipeline.vad_hint: Skip silent regions automatically to save GPU time. Usually on.
pipeline.uvr_hint: Separate vocals from BGM and effects. Heavy; only useful for music-track audio.
pipeline.diarize_hint: Auto-label who is speaking. Requires a HuggingFace token.
pipeline.diarize_cost_hint: ~30s first-use model load · ~2 extra min on a 60-min recording
pipeline.diarize_speakers_hint: Leave blank to auto-estimate. Set both when you know the cast (e.g. 2-host podcast → 2 ~ 2).
pipeline.translate_hint: Generate target-language translation alongside the source.

bench.title: Performance benchmark
bench.hint: Measures sequential / batched / concurrent speed on your current model and recommends the best mode.
bench.running_hint: Running. Each strategy loads the model again, so this can take a few minutes.
bench.summary_none: Not measured yet. Find the best processing mode for this machine.

settings.processing_hint: Execution mode for file/YouTube jobs. Run the performance benchmark to see which is faster.
settings.compute_type_hint: Trade VRAM for accuracy. int8 variants are light, float is accurate.
settings.pipeline_default_caption: Global defaults. Each job page can override these.

hf.access_title: Token set, but model terms aren't accepted
hf.access_body: Your token is valid, but this account hasn't accepted the gated terms for the three models below. Click ‘Agree and access repository’ once on each page.
hf.access_note: This card flips to ‘Ready’ within 30s of the fix. An ai restart may be needed.
hf.perm_body: Terms are accepted, but the token itself doesn't have the ‘access public gated repos’ scope (common with fine-grained tokens). It's a 403, which is why it failed silently until now.
hf.perm_step_a: Easiest: create a new ‘Read’ type token (gated access is automatic)
hf.perm_step_b: Or enable ‘Read access to public gated repos’ on the current token
hf.perm_step_restart: Swap AI_HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN in .env, then docker compose restart ai
hf.ready_body: Speaker diarization is ready. The pyannote model loads on first use and persists per the model-idle window in Settings.
hf.needs_intro: Speaker diarization (pyannote) needs a HuggingFace token. The UI doesn't accept it directly; drop it into .env once and it just works.
hf.step_terms_suffix: · accept the terms on all three model pages
hf.step_token: Create a token at HuggingFace settings → Access Tokens
hf.step_env: Add to .env at the project root:
hf.step_restart: Restart the ai container with: docker compose up -d ai
hf.auto_refresh_note: This card polls ai every 30s. The status flips to ‘Ready’ shortly after the restart completes.

advanced.title: Whisper decoding options
advanced.compression_hint: Lower → drop redundant/looping text more aggressively (default 2.4)
advanced.repetition_hint: >1 penalises repeated tokens. faster-whisper / HF only
advanced.hallucination_silence_hint: Drop text Whisper generates inside silent runs longer than this (sec). Kills the "Thanks for watching" tail hallucination. 0 = off
advanced.condition_hint: On = more hallucination risk (phrase looping). Off by default

transcript.edit_hint: Click → play · double-click → edit · select rows → retranscribe range
transcript.click_hint: Click to play, double-click to edit
transcript.coach_title: What you can do in this editor
transcript.coach_body: Select rows with the left checkbox → ‘Retranscribe this range’ in the toolbar (Song/Noisy presets). · Select one row to drag its edges on the waveform and retime it. · Drag across the waveform to pick a new span (the only way when the transcript is empty). · The ⋯ menu at the row end has insert · duplicate · move · merge.
transcript.audio_unavailable: Realtime session · audio isn't kept. You can still edit and export the transcript.
transcript.split_tooltip: Split this segment at the cursor
transcript.speaker_rename_tooltip: Click to rename this speaker: every segment with this label is updated
transcript.speaker_edit_tooltip: Change this row's speaker, or rename the label everywhere
transcript.speaker_assign_tooltip: Assign a speaker to this row
transcript.speaker_pick: Set this row to another speaker
transcript.drag_hint: Drag across the waveform to retranscribe just that time span
transcript.empty_drag_hint: No speech recognised. Drag across the waveform to pick a span, then retry with the ‘Song’ preset
transcript.align_speakers_hint: Use the selected lines as reference voices and re-assign every other line to the closest reference speaker. The selected lines keep their labels.
transcript.retranscribe_emptied: Retranscribe returned nothing: the old lines were removed
transcript.move_tooltip: Move this line to another time
transcript.overlap_warning: This subtitle's time overlaps a neighbour. Click the start/end time to adjust.

region.uvr_hint: Isolate vocals from BGM · great for songs
region.temperature_hint: 0 is most stable. Higher tries more varied candidates (keep at 0 to reduce loops/hallucination)

job.cancelling_hint: The worker will stop after its current step. Usually a few seconds.
job.cancel_waiting_hint: Waiting for the worker to ack; should flip to ‘cancelled’ within seconds.
job.failed_hint: Check the error on the left panel. To retry with the same options, delete this job and start a fresh one.
job.cancelled_hint: To re-run, delete it and start a new job from the same source.
job.retry_failed: Retry failed. Check the source file still exists.
job.gated_title: No access to the diarization model
job.gated_body: Your HF token is valid, but its account hasn't accepted the terms for the three models below. The token alone isn't enough: you must click ‘Agree’ once on each page.
job.gated_step_agree: click ‘Agree and access repository’ on the page
job.gated_step_restart: Then retry the job (no ai restart needed)
job.youtube_blocked_title: YouTube blocked the download (not your audio)
job.youtube_blocked_body: This is YouTube's side, not your file. Usually one of three things:
job.youtube_blocked_fix1: yt-dlp is outdated → YouTube changes often. Rebuild the ai image for the latest (docker compose build ai)
job.youtube_blocked_fix2: Video is private / age- or region-restricted → needs login/cookies to download
job.youtube_blocked_fix3: Temporary bot wall → retry shortly, or download the file yourself and upload it

cache.title: YouTube cache
cache.hint: YouTube audio is cached by video id so retries / re-runs don't re-download. Oldest files are auto-evicted when the cache is over the limit.

hotkeys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
hotkeys.sc_cancel: Cancel segment edit · cancel realtime preparing

palette.placeholder: Jump to page · change mode · switch theme

dashboard.job_pending: Transcribing. The editor opens when the job finishes.
dashboard.intro_body: Start from a file, a YouTube URL, or your microphone. Export as SRT/VTT/TXT, edit inline before exporting.

history.delete_confirm: Delete this job permanently? Transcript and output files will be removed.
history.empty_hint: Start one from the File · YouTube · Realtime page
history.bulk_delete_confirm: Delete {{count}} jobs permanently? Transcripts and output files are removed.
history.cancel_job_confirm: Cancel this job? Any in-flight transcription will be stopped.

error.oom: GPU out of memory. Try a smaller model.
